name: trace-viz
description: Визуализатор distributed trace-логов. Загрузка через файл или буфер обмена → парсинг → нормализация → иерархия → рендеринг. OpenTelemetry / Elasticsearch / OpenSearch форматы

scripts.build:zip: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('mkdir dist', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch(e){}; const tag = execSync('git describe --tags --abbrev=0').toString().trim(); const out = 'dist/trace-viz-' + tag + '.zip'; execSync('git archive --format=zip --output=' + out + ' HEAD', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('✅ Сборка:', out);"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.commit:feat: node -e "const msg = process.argv.slice(1).join('\n'); require('child_process').execSync('git commit -m \"feat: ' + msg + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });" --
scripts.commit:fix: node -e "const msg = process.argv.slice(1).join('\n'); require('child_process').execSync('git commit -m \"fix: ' + msg + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });" --
scripts.commit:refactor: node -e "const msg = process.argv.slice(1).join('\n'); require('child_process').execSync('git commit -m \"refactor: ' + msg + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });" --
scripts.commit:style: node -e "const msg = process.argv.slice(1).join('\n'); require('child_process').execSync('git commit -m \"style: ' + msg + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });" --
scripts.commit:docs: node -e "const msg = process.argv.slice(1).join('\n'); require('child_process').execSync('git commit -m \"docs: ' + msg + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });" --
scripts.commit:release: node -e "const msg = process.argv.slice(1).join('\n'); require('child_process').execSync('git commit -m \"release: ' + msg + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });" --
scripts.merge:master: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const tag = execSync('git describe --tags --abbrev=0').toString().trim(); execSync('git checkout master && git merge ' + tag + ' -m \"merge: тэг ' + tag + ' в master\"', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.tag: node -e "const v = require('./package.json').version; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('git tag -a v' + v + ' -m \"release: v' + v + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('✅ Тэг v' + v);"
scripts.push:all: git push origin master && git push origin develop && git push origin --tags && git push sourcecraft master && git push sourcecraft develop && git push sourcecraft --tags || echo '⚠️ Проверьте наличие remote: sourcecraft'
